scraped_extras.bio:
Administrative: I currently serve as the chair of the Department of Computer Science & Automation.
Brief Bio: Since 2017 I have been a Professor in the Department of Computer Science & Automation at the Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore, where I have been serving as chair starting September 2023. From 2007 to 2017, I was a faculty member in the Department of Computer Science at Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey. In 2007, I earned a Ph.D. degree in Computer Science from the University of Wisconsin-Madison★, and in 2001 a B.Tech. in Computer Science & Engineering from IIT Bombay.
Work: The primary focus of my research is computer security. At IISc, I direct the Computer Systems Security Laboratory. My research projects have considered security and privacy issues in a broad spectrum of computer systems, such as cloud platforms, Web browsers, mobile devices, drones/robots, and devices on the electrical power grid. I have wide-ranging interests, and my projects usually draw on ideas and methods developed in a variety of areas, such as applied cryptography, program analysis, formal methods, machine intelligence, and hardware architecture. Please consult my publications for details. I usually teach courses in computer systems and security.

scraped_extras.bio:
I am a Professor at Dept. of Computer Science & Automation (CSA), EECS Division, Indian Institute of Science Bangalore, India. Together with my students, I am part of the Cryptography and Information Security (CrIS) Lab. At IISc, I am also associated with the Theoretical Computer Science Group at CSA, Security Group at EECS, AI @ IISc at IISc and Robert Bosch Centre for Cyber-Physical Systems at IISc.
I worked with Silence Laboratories as a visiting professor in the summer of 2024. I served as a visiting faculty researcher at Google Research between August 2022 -- July 2023.
Prior to coming to IISc, I spent three wonderful years as post-doctoral fellows at University of Bristol, UK (hosted by Prof. Nigel Smart), ETH Zurich, Switzerland (hosted by Prof. Ueli Maurer) and Aarhus University, Denmark (hosted by Prof. Ivan Damgaard). I spent five and half years of my student life at IIT Madras doing PhD (with Prof. C. Pandu Rangan) and Master of Science by Research (with Prof. Sukhendu Das).
Born in a remote village of West Bengal, I graduated from Haldia Institute of Technology and completed my initial studies from Kumarpur Hateswar High School and Gobardhanpur Pramathanath Vidyayatan, West Bengal.
Apart from science, I have artistic inclinations towards photography, painting, and writing. I enjoy playing various sports such as sprinting, marathon, cycling, badminton, yoga and swimming.
Please visit Cryptography and Information Security (CrIS) Lab for open positions!

scraped_extras.bio:
Welcome to my home page. I am a Professor in the Department of Computer Science and Automation at IISc Bangalore. I head the Visualization and Graphics Lab, and am part of the Visual Analytics Group. Prior to joining IISc, I was a postdoctoral researcher in the Institute for Data Analysis and Visualization at University of California, Davis. I graduated with a Ph.D. in computer science from Duke University.
I was a Guest Professor at Zuse Institute Berlin in 2013-2014 and 2023-2024 on a fellowship from the Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and as a Berlin MATH+ Visiting Scholar.
My current research interests include scientific visualization, computational topology, computational geometry, and geometry processing. Detailed descriptions of current and previous research projects is available within the Visualization and Graphics Lab pages. Mimyk is a startup co-founded by VGL and M2D2 lab alum that is developing immersive technologies for medical simulation.
If you are a non-IISc student who wishes to contact me regarding an intern or project assistant position, please read this note first.

Arka (prava) is an associate professor at the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bangalore where he marshals the Computer Systems Lab. Before joining IISc in 2018, he worked as a full-time member of the research staff at AMD Research in Austin, USA, for four years. Earlier, Arka obtained his Ph.D. in computer science from the University of Wisconsin-Madison, USA in December 2013.
Arka received Intel Rising Star Faculty Award 2021. He is one of the only ten recipients of this award from universities across the globe. Arka is also recipients of Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Award 2025, MICRO Hall of fame 2024, Google India Research award for 2021 and 2023, Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Young Researcher HPC Award 2021, and Pratiksha Trust Young Investigator Award for 2020-2022.

scraped_extras.bio:
Assistant Professor
Department of Computer Science and Automation (CSA),
Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru.
Starting Oct. 2024, I am an Assistant Professor in the Department of Computer Science and Automation (CSA) at Indian Institute of Science (IISc). I lead the Theoretical Foundations of ML and Optimization Lab (TFMLO Lab) at Indian Institute of Science (IISc).
Previously, I was a Marie-Curie Fellow, jointly hosted by Prof. Francis Bach at SIERRA Project Team (Inria) and Prof. Maxim Raginsky at Coordinated Science Laboratory (CSL), UIUC till Sept. 2024. Before that, I completed my PhD in Machine Learning at Max-Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems in the Empirical Inference Department under the supervision of Prof. Bernhard Schoelkopf. I received my B.Tech-M.Tech dual degree in Electrical Engineering from IIT Kanpur where my research was advised by Prof. Rajesh M Hegde, Prof. Vinay Namboodiri, Prof. Amitabha Mukerjee and Prof. Tinne Tuytelaars (External Master's Thesis Advisor).
My research interest is in understanding problems in general machine learning theory and applications. More specifically, I am interested in optimization theory, kernel methods and theoretical foundation of machine learning. I have also a vivid interest in understanding the resource efficient learning such as active learning, coresets and distributed inference. On the application side, I am interested in application of machine learning methods in healthcare domain.
If you are passionate about optimization theory and machine learning theory and are interested in joining my research group, please take a moment to read this information before reaching out !!
July 2025: Presented our paper on Mean-Field Optimisation at COLT 2025 and visited SIERRA Research Team at Inria, Paris.

I am an Assistant Professor of the Robert Bosch Centre for Cyber Physical Systems (RBCCPS) and the Department of Computer Science and Automation (CSA) in IISc Bangalore. I received my Ph.D. degree in Mechanical Engineering (2016) from the Georgia Institute of Technology, M.S. degree in Electrical Engineering (2012) from Texas A&M University, and B.Tech. degree in Electrical Engineering (2008) from the National Institute of Technology Karnataka, Surathkal. I started my career in the field of robotics, especially in the domain of legged robots. My primary focus as a PhD student was on stability and control of walking robots. I have diversified to other fields like safety-critical control, and machine learning for all kinds of robotic platforms. bio
